sourceObservations.finding: Apple dates the launch October 15, opened pre-orders October 16 and positions A20 Pro, the foldable inner display and iOS 27 for multitasking.
Apple names Split View and several productivity/creative application layouts, while noting that some updates are still rolling out; exact versions and firsthand value remain unverified.
Apple Netherlands identifies model A3720, the display sizes, 254 gram weight, camera set, USB-C capabilities and dual-eSIM-only design.
Apple Netherlands lists 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB and 2 TB configurations; the 256 GB price observed was EUR 2,339 including VAT and expires from editorial use after 24 hours without recheck.
The official page offers downloadable launch media, but no per-asset commercial reuse permission receipt was established; no media was copied.
Samsung, Lenovo and HONOR regional checks did not clear the previously recorded exact-SKU, firsthand-evidence or rights conditions.
